hypothesis: V2 captures familiar vendor skeletons better than custom SmartRig graphs. Captured joint trajectories would then retarget onto the original SmartRig mesh.
selectionPolicy: anatomical compatibility before sprite inference; at most two candidates per asset; freeze the chosen reference across that asset's clips

primary.why: Original Swordsman bind views and CSWORD idle show a biped with paired arms and legs, a spine and head. The reviewed 25-joint donor recipe covers this graph. The longsword and shield are rigid hand attachments, not independently articulated capture joints.
primary.concerns: No independent fingers. Sword and shield follow the holding hands; two-handed contact and physical ownership remain unreviewed.

primary.why: Original Monk bind views and CMONKK idle show a biped under a robe with paired sleeves, a spine and a hooded head. The reviewed 25-joint donor recipe covers this graph. The source mesh has no leg bones; Mixamo legs are authored at the hem and are not independently articulated capture joints.
primary.concerns: No independent fingers, face, or legs. Robe hem follow-through and tucked-sleeve hands remain unreviewed.

primary.why: Original Marksman bind views and CHCBOW idle show a biped with paired arms and legs, a spine and head. The reviewed 25-joint donor recipe covers this graph. The longbow is a rigid left-hand attachment; the lower limb parented under the right palm is not an independently articulated capture joint.
primary.concerns: No independent fingers or bowstring joint. Two-hand draw contact and quiver/cloak follow-through remain unreviewed.

primary.why: Original Archer bind views and CLCBOW idle show a biped with paired arms and legs, a spine and head. The reviewed 25-joint donor recipe covers this graph. The crossbow is a rigid left-hand attachment, not an independently articulated capture joint.
primary.concerns: No independent fingers, bowstring, or bolt-release joint. Fitted motion and bow attachment require visual review.

primary.why: Original Pikeman bind views and its own CPKMAN idle sprite show a biped with paired arms and legs, a spine and head. The reviewed 25-joint donor recipe covers this graph; source anatomy and preprocessing remain unit-owned.
primary.concerns: No independent fingers or pike capture joint. The rigid pike follows the lower right hand; independent upper-left-hand shaft contact is not enforced and must be reviewed in motion.

primary.why: Complete installed package used by the successful vendor known-motion control. Flyer graph: hips to pelvis; pelvis to tail and spine; spine to two thighs and spine1; spine1 to two wings and neck.

anatomy.limbAttachment: paired thighs on spine; paired wings on spine1; tail on pelvis
anatomy.branchIdentity: named left/right wings, legs, tail, toes
anatomy.articulationCoverage: wing chains, leg chains, neck/head, tail

comparison.why: Second complete flyer package with a different wing-arm naming graph (BN_UpperArm / BN_Forearm, 53 joints). Not a search by animation score. Use only if the Eagle primary fails the source-action test.

anatomy.limbAttachment: paired wing-arms and legs on a bird spine

primary.why: Complete Mixamo humanoid with 25 joints: hips to spine plus two legs plus two arms plus head. No finger fan. Chosen for central biped structure, not because it has a demo score.

anatomy.limbAttachment: LeftUpLeg/RightUpLeg on hips; shoulders on the spine chain

primary.concerns: No expected_results video in this mini demo. Generic Objaverse character, not a knight mesh.

comparison.why: Second humanoid package. This is the vendor obj known-motion control (69 joints, fingers/jaw/eyes, demo + expected video). Heavier than needed; use only if the 25-joint primary fails the source-action test.

anatomy.limbAttachment: paired legs on hips; paired arms on the spine chain
anatomy.branchIdentity: left/right Mixamo-style names plus finger fans

comparison.concerns: Finger-heavy. Image embed only on y0.

primary.concerns: No independent finger or claw articulation. Captured motion and skin deformation remain experimental, not visually accepted.

primary.why: Reviewed biped anatomy with rigid hand-owned club; complete 25-joint capture graph retained.
primary.concerns: No independent fingers or weapon capture joint; generated motion requires visual review.

primary.concerns: No independent finger articulation. Weapon attachment and motion require generated-preview review.

h3_beholder.why: No installed zoo or obj package is a central globe with several similar-length tentacle chains. Snakes are one or two body chains. Obj packages on disk are Mixamo humanoids. Successful Roc capture alone does not establish a shared pipeline.
rejectedLookalikes: Spider / SpiderG / Scorpion / Ant / FireAnt / Roach / Centipede / Crab — many similar chains, but legs or pincers, not tentacles
Anaconda / KingCobra — long body chains, not a globe hub
Mixamo finger fans — hand digits, not tentacles
